quarterly_data.signal: Sumitomo Metal Mining says it has developed a 12-inch (300mm) bonded silicon carbide (SiC) substrate, SiCkrest(R), and has begun sample shipment to a semiconductor manufacturer (not named). The company says it is the world's first 12-inch SiC substrate achieved through bonding, according to its own research (company claim). It positions the substrate for growing demand for larger-diameter SiC substrates in the power semiconductor market and will exhibit it at ICSCRM 2026 (Pacifico Yokohama North, September 27 to October 2, Booth G-2). Samples only; no mass-production date, volumes or prices stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 12-inch (300mm) bonded SiC substrate; sample shipment begun
